scope: Actual extracted native Swift ad methods, controlled SDK/UI boundaries, accelerated timer clock; no live Google/Apple request. Not physical SDK callback acceptance.

failures.failure: Automatic retry recovers a failed first-session update
Recovered consent starts one SDK and loads one ad
Repeat initialization and foreground do not duplicate a ready ad
Background launch performs no consent form or ad request
Returning update does not present from a suspended controller
Foreground retries the abandoned presentation path
A failed refresh can use only actual SDK-granted prior consent
Privacy refresh recovers without duplicate initialization or preloads
Failed required form retries through a fresh consent update
Only the successful form enables first-session loading
Preload waits for its real callback
Old preload callback cannot become ready while privacy choices are open
Privacy choices start while an older preload awaits completion
A late old callback reloads even when the form already closed
SDK-ready video accepts its original request ID
Only SDK earned callback carries the original reward identity
